name: country-select
title: Country Select
description: A searchable country combobox returning the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, with flag + name. Built on Combobox.

A THIN, data-fed composition of our `Combobox`: `items={countries}`, a * `BaseCombobox.Trigger` styled as a full-width `Button` (the "Select-style" pattern — see * combobox.tsx's own JSDoc), and the search `ComboboxPopupInput` living INSIDE `ComboboxContent` * (`inputInsidePopup`), which is what gives the trigger `role="combobox"` + * `aria-haspopup="dialog"` instead of a bare icon-only trigger. Pure presentational + controlled * (`value` + `onValueChange`); the consuming app owns the selected code. * * NOTE: `ComboboxTrigger` (combobox.tsx's own wrapper) always wraps its `children` in Base UI's * `Combobox.Icon`, which is unconditionally `aria-hidden` (verified: `ComboboxIcon.mjs` hard-codes * it) — correct for an icon-only trigger, but it would silently hide a text label.
